summary: Leap into planes in a car! Can you handle the thrilling chase?
description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!

Embark on a wacky journey of vehicular resilience! You're not just trying to catch flights at the terminal; you're racing to literally leap into the plane! Each level has you speeding behind a plane, strategically dodging absurd obstacles and making wild jumps with only one goal: to land in that plane with style. Initially, you might feel like a toddler chasing pigeons—hopeless. But with each attempt, collect coins to soup up your ride. Boost your engine, fuel up, and inflate those moneybags because the chase keeps getting crazier!

Think it's a straight road to the win? Think again! Levels throw curveballs with multiple paths. Will you risk the rickety rooftop route or the highway of havoc? Make split-second choices that either bump you up or grind your gears down!

Customizations? Oh, we got them! Make your getaway car your best ally. But remember, no amount of spoilers or shiny rims will help you if you run out of fuel. Strategy is your co-pilot on this flight!

Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

IGRS rating: 13+
